Question: For each positive integer \(n,\) let \(f_1(n)\) be twice the number of positive integer divisors of \(n,\) and for \(j \ge 2,\) let \(f_j(n) = f_1(f_{j-1}(n)).\) For how many values of \(n \le 50\) is \(f_{50}(n) = 12?\)
